reviews.title: No recent updates; leaves ads unblocked
reviews.text:
We all know that ad blocking is a constant cat-and-mouse game between the platforms hosting the ads and the tools blocking them. 

Unfortunately, this app seems to have given up the game and no longer blocks ads on several social platforms at all. So sad, because until recently, both “post ads” and “reel ads” were blocked consistently and seamlessly, making the platform actually usable on mobile — without ads and without tracking.

I would love to return to Friendly if there’s ever an update that restores the great functionality, but for now I’m uninstalling it.

reviews.title: Friendly X App Is What Happens When Nobody Tests the Product Before Launch
reviews.text:
I was using the Friendly X app when they suddenly locked me out without any warning. Every time I try to log in, I get the message: “You are temporarily locked out. Please try again later.”

I contacted Friendly’s technical support and received exactly zero response. What’s even more ridiculous is that every other X app on the iPhone App Store works perfectly fine—only Friendly is broken.

At this point, “Friendly” might be the most misleading app name in the App Store. Locking out users without notice and then ghosting support requests is a great way to lose customers. Save yourself the headache and use literally any other X app.
